column3: “the oak(s)” renders a word that may mean “terebinth” or “great tree.”
“My lord” is lowercase in NASB; the Hebrew vowels read “Adonai” (Lord).
“that you may refresh yourselves” renders “and sustain your heart.”
“at this time next year” renders “at the time of life (when it revives).”
“I have chosen him” renders “I have known him.”
Jewish scribal tradition says the original read “the LORD was still standing before Abraham.”
